diagnoses.description:
Ambiguous sign convention for affine translation vs. camera motion; not empirically calibrated on a known-direction clip.
Evidence: Sign convention encoded in solve.py: "dx>0→Pan Left else Pan Right". Frame-wise dx values were "consistent dx≈−20..−25" per the rolling summary, producing "Pan Right" labels. Whether negative dx of the estimated affine (image-space translation of features) corresponds to a rightward camera pan depends on whether the affine maps prev→curr or curr→prev. This mapping was never explicitly verified against ground truth, and the agent's own summary describes the scene as a walking POV — the pan direction assignment could be inverted.
Trajectory location: turn 3 / turn 18 (egomotion labels)

A 2D affine flow model over-fits parallax-induced flow, so genuine slow-moving objects may be absorbed into the model and missed; conversely the largest mask (f6, 9.34%) may be dominated by parallax on nearby stall objects rather than real dynamic content. Threshold floor (3 px) plus min-area 2765 px suppresses small movers.
Evidence: Agent's own final note: "residuals near the closest foreground objects (e.g. the hanging umbrella/clothes on the right stall) can appear in the mask alongside genuinely moving content." Most frames have 0% mask (f2, f3, f9–f17) despite the scene being a busy NYC sidewalk which almost certainly contains moving pedestrians/vehicles.
Trajectory location: turn 11 / turn 18 (dynamic masks)

Possible inconsistency between rolling-summary claim of the frame-10 dy value and actual per-frame labels; either the outlier was smaller than reported or thresholds excluded it. Without terminal ground truth we cannot tell whether coarser merged intervals under- or over-count motion transitions.
Evidence: Only 3 intervals over 18 frames: "0->3":Stay, "3->6":Pan Right, "6->18":[Dolly In, Pan Right]. Frame 10 was flagged as an outlier (dx=−40, dy=−24, scale=1.06) but its labels evidently merged into the surrounding [Dolly In, Pan Right] set rather than introducing a Tilt Down interval, because |dy|=24 exceeded TH_TRANS=8 yet the agent did not re-inspect. If dy really was 24 there, "Tilt Down" (dy<0 branch) would have been emitted and the interval would have split.
Trajectory location: turn 3 (egomotion merging granularity)
